messages:
ellie (acct): Heads-up — ShieldBank moved our security review to tomorrow 10am PT. They want a short demo + answers for KMS envelope flow, RBAC mappings, and how we show audit logs. Can we triage what to surface?

maria (sec): Thanks. I'll own KMS + audit logs. Main asks I saw: customer key import, HSM vs cloud KMS proof, and log proof for admin actions.

raj (sre): I'll prep the log retention and ingest diagram. Also will grab sample query output for admin events (who did what).

kelsey (eng): For RBAC they specifically asked about service accounts vs user role bindings and least privilege examples. I can sketch a mapping from ShieldBank roles -> our roles.

sam (solutions): I'll run through the demo flow and confirm we can show live logs without PII. Need to know if we have a scrubbed sample for the console.

maria (sec): Quick decisions: we should show (1) KMS envelope flow diagram, (2) a redacted audit log snippet with event IDs, (3) RBAC mapping table. Also prepare an answer for key custody and rotation cadence.

ellie (acct): They're going to ask about evidence for rotation and proof of zero-key access by our ops. Could we pull rotation logs?

raj (sre): Yes — rotation events are in the key-manager audit stream. Example query:

```sql
SELECT time, event_type, user, key_id, rotation_id FROM key_audit
WHERE key_id = 'env-123' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10;
```

kelsey (eng): Note: for on-prem/private deployments we ship a customer-managed KMS option. For hosted we use envelope encryption with customer-provided KEKs via KMS integration. I'll prepare one-sentence contrasts.

maria (sec): On the HSM question — ShieldBank will ask for attestations. We have SOC2 + HSM customer pilots where we integrate an HSM-backed KMS. Point them to our compliance page and offer an HSM-specific runbook.

sam (solutions): For RBAC mapping, quick draft: ShieldBank Admin -> Redwood org-admin role (no data-plane key access), DevOps -> model-deploy role (can deploy models, no key export), Audit -> read-only logs role. Can someone validate?

kelsey (eng): That mapping looks good. Add a conditional: for Dedicated customers we can create tenant-scoped roles and service accounts with token-scoped permissions.

maria (sec): Also prepare the incident playbook snippet. ShieldBank will ask: if a key compromise is suspected, what's the containment and evidence collection? I suggest we show the 4-step: contain (revoke), rotate, forensic snapshot, customer notification.

raj (sre): I'll attach the runbook excerpt in the thread before EOD. triage-bot: remind #eng-security in 2 hours to review artifacts.

triage-bot: Reminder scheduled: review_shieldbank_artifacts in 2h.

ellie (acct): Can we produce a redacted audit log sample showing an admin role granting a permission and the associated token/actor? They want to see immutable proof.

maria (sec): Yes. We'll redact identifying fields and keep event_id, timestamp, action, actor_role. Example line I'll paste in the deck.

kelsey (eng): One gotcha: ShieldBank asked about cross-tenant access via service accounts. We must confirm there is no implicit cross-tenant role binding in Dedicated/Private. I'll add the explicit statement.

sam (solutions): Any concerns about live demo access? We should use a pre-recorded clip for rotation and a live console for RBAC mapping only. Lower blast radius.

maria (sec): Agreed. Demo plan: recorded KMS rotation + envelope lifecycle, live console to show RBAC UI and redacted audit query.

ellie (acct): Great. Who can join the call? I need at least one sec + one engineer.

maria (sec): I'll join. raj can you make 10am PT?

raj (sre): Yep.

kelsey (eng): I'll be there too for RBAC questions.

sam (solutions): I can cover the product narrative.

ellie (acct): Perfect. Action items: Maria — one-slide KMS + redacted log snippet; Raj — runbook excerpt + rotation query output; Kelsey — RBAC mapping table and explicit statement about no cross-tenant access; Sam — demo clip + narrative. Thread last call to review at 2pm PT today.

maria (sec): Working on slide now, will post draft by 5pm PT.

raj (sre): Runbook excerpt posted: https://internal.redwood/shieldbank/runbook (redacted).

kelsey (eng): RBAC mapping table draft attached to the doc.

sam (solutions): Uploaded demo clip to drive. Will also record a 2-min backup video in case live fails.

ellie (acct): Thanks team. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
